Saudi Arabia and its allies dispatched top security officials to Iran for talks on Monday amid fears of a fresh US-Israeli offensive that could plunge the Middle East into further instability.

The meeting in Tehran comes at a tense moment in the Middle East as speculation grows that President Donald Trump could order new strikes on Iran after next week’s midterm elections. It also marks the first high-level contact between Iran and Saudi Arabia since Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis escalated attacks against Saudi targets last month.

US Army Maj. Gen. James "Spider" Marks (retired) & CNN Abu Dhabi managing editor Becky Anderson break down what the Iran meeting may mean and unpack the implications of a new offensive.

description:
On the campaign trail in 2024, President Donald Trump promised to make gas dirt-cheap again and blamed record-high gas prices on the Biden-Harris “war on energy.” 

But then an actual war got in the way: Trump’s deeply unpopular conflict with Iran. 

Nearly eight months into a war that has destabilized the global energy system, the average price of gas during Trump’s second term is now more expensive than it was during the Biden era, according to a CNN analysis of AAA data. 

CNN's Matt Egan runs through the numbers and CNN White House correspondent Alayna Treene reports on the Trump administration's concerns over gas prices heading into the midterm elections. Also, CNN political commentator S.E. Cupp and former Wisconsin governor Scott Walker react to Trump's messaging on high gas prices.

title: Gas under Trump 2.0 is now more expensive than under Biden

With just over a week to go in the midterm elections, President Donald Trump and former President Barack Obama both held rallies over the weekend as they stumped for their parties’ candidates. 

In Michigan, Obama renewed criticism of the years of “chaos, and cruelty, and corruption” under Trump’s administration, echoing his earlier comments in Ohio. 

Meanwhile, Trump appeared to acknowledge the headwinds facing Republicans in Georgia, telling supporters that a GOP Senate win there would be “somewhat of a shocker.” 

CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten breaks down Obama's favorability advantage over Trump. Also, CNN's Arlette Saenz reports from Michigan and CNN's Audie Cornish and her CNN This Morning "group chat" debate the effectiveness of Obama and Trump's dueling messages ahead of the midterm elections.

description:
SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has accused Ukraine’s military of violating Starlink’s terms of service, after Kyiv said that access to the service had been restored. 

In a post on X Saturday, Musk said that Ukraine’s armed forces had “violated Starlink terms of service and used it for offensive drone strikes to kill people.” 

Zelensky’s adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov disputed Musk’s accusation that Ukraine is using the commercial service to kill people, saying speed restrictions and the service’s unavailability over Russian territory made Ukraine “physically unable to use commercial Starlink” for medium- and long-range strikes into Russia. 

CNN's Sebastian Shukla has details, while Russia expert Jill Dougherty and CNN contributor Kara Swisher give their reactions to Musk's involvement in the Ukraine war.
